tasks.title: Rust: DOCX revisions typed — w:ins/w:del/moveFrom/moveTo spans with author/date round-trip
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 4 item 1 (revisions). ORM-05 Logic/Annotations.cpp row: ins/del/move revisions dropped. P2-06 preserves settings.xml bytes but revision MARKS on runs vanish semantically. Add a typed revision span model: DocxRun revision field (Option<DocxRevision{kind: Insert|Delete|MoveFrom|MoveTo, author, date, id}>) + paragraph-level pPrChange/rPrChange skip is fine (runs only). Parser: read w:ins/w:del wrappers around runs and w:delText as Delete text; serializer re-emits the wrappers so tracked changes survive round-trip MANAGED (not via byte bag) — remove document.xml from any bag-only thinking, it is already managed. Engine surface: OoxmlDocument exposes revision_count()/revisions() (serde) so the UI track-changes rail can count. Pin with converter_gaps gap_docx_revisions_roundtrip: docx with one w:ins (author='A', date) and one w:del (w:delText 'gone') -> parse -> 2 typed revisions (1 ins 1 del, author A) -> serialize -> reparse -> same 2. Baselines: wo-ooxml 89 lib, converter_gaps 30 passing; keep green.

tasks.title: Rust: OMML math — m:oMath/m:oMathPara verbatim + linear text extraction, managed round-trip
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 4 item 1 (OMML). ORM-05 Math/oMathContent.h missing — equations deleted by parse_run fall-through. Two-layer fix: (1) capture: parse arm for m:oMath / m:oMathPara inside runs producing DocxRun::Math{ xml: String (verbatim), linear: String } where linear extracts m:t text in document order with spaces (good enough for search/copy). (2) serialize: re-emit the verbatim xml as a proper m:oMath run child so equations round-trip managed; converter HTML path renders the linear text in a <span class=wo-math> so equations are at least VISIBLE in html output (grep wo-x2t converters.rs html arm — that file is OUT of scope, instead the html integration point is acceptable via the model: the linear field exists for consumers; do not edit wo-x2t). Pin with converter_gaps gap_docx_math_roundtrip: docx with m:oMath containing m:r/m:t 'x+1' and a fraction -> parse -> Math run with linear containing 'x+1' -> serialize -> reparse -> Math still present with same m:t content. Keep wo-ooxml 89+ / converter_gaps green.

tasks.title: Rust: Flat OPC entry (single-XML docx) + typed DocxSettings slice (track-changes/protection defaults)
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 4 item 1 (DocxFlat 403 lines + Settings.h 1048). (1) Flat OPC: wo-ooxml detector.rs currently sniffs zip OPC only. Add flat detection: input not a zip but starts with optional XML decl/BOM then contains <w:document — detect as flat WordprocessingML; parse by feeding the raw xml straight into the existing document.xml reader (the parser reads a str, so reuse), and on serialize emit a ZIP package (flat in, zip out is standard modernization — note it in the ledger). (2) Typed settings slice: parse word/settings.xml (when present) into DocxSettings{ track_changes: bool, rsids: Vec<String> (cap 50), default_tab_stop, auto_hyphenation } exposed on OoxmlDocument; serializer re-emits settings.xml MANAGED from the typed struct plus preserved unknown children via a captured raw tail (cheap: keep original bytes for children we do not model, emit ours first then raw children of the original root). Pin with converter_gaps gap_flat_opc_entry (flat <w:document xml string -> parse -> paragraphs -> serialize -> reparse zip form ok) and gap_settings_typed_roundtrip (settings with w:trackChanges on -> parse -> settings.track_changes true -> serialize -> reparse still true). Keep all green.

tasks.title: Rust: XLSX pivot grouping + calculated items — wo-sheet PivotField buckets, cache round-trip
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 4 item 2 (xlsx tail). wo-sheet pivot.rs has PivotField/PivotValueField/AggFunc and grouping happens by value equality only. Add: (1) numeric range grouping — PivotField.group_ranges: Vec<(f64,f64)> (start,end,step semantics: derive buckets start..end by step) applied in the row/column grouping pass so 100 rows of numbers collapse to range buckets; (2) date-period grouping — group_period: Option<Year|Quarter|Month|Day> bucketing date-ish strings (ISO y-m-d) by period; (3) calculated items — PivotValueField.formula: Option<String> (e.g. '2*[Sales]') evaluated AFTER aggregation against sibling field totals (tiny evaluator: field refs in [] times scalar +-*/; refuse gracefully -> None if unparsable). wo-ooxml side: parse xl/pivotCache definitions' fieldGrouping (rangePr start/end/step, groupItems) into the typed workbook model so grouping survives round trip (serializer emits them). Pin with converter_gaps gap_xlsx_pivot_grouping: pivot on numeric rows with group ranges 0-100 step 50 -> 2 buckets each summing its rows; calculated field '2*[A]' doubles. wo-sheet baseline 222 — keep green (pivot tests live in wo-sheet lib tests or a new pivot_group_tests module registered in lib.rs).

tasks.title: Rust: PPTX typed timing tree + SmartArt managed part
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 4 item 2 (pptx tail). (1) Timing tree: parser has parse_pptx_timing_raw (raw string) + AnimationData flat. Add a typed TimingTree{ nodes: Vec<TimeNode{ id, kind: Par|Seq|Anim|Set|Behavior, delay_ms, duration_ms, repeat: Option<u32>, children: Vec<TimeNode> }> } parsed from p:timing (recursive ct_TLTimeNode descend), exposed on Slide, serializer re-emits timing from the tree (raw string becomes derived fallback — keep raw for fidelity when tree parse fails). (2) SmartArt: diagrams survive only via the P2-06 docx byte bag; for PPTX, make ppt/diagrams/* + ppt/smartArt* MANAGED parts typed as SmartArtData{ layout_xml, data_xml, colors_xml (all raw strings) } referenced from the slide rels, so serializer regenerates them (byte-exact from the raw captures). Pin with converter_gaps gap_pptx_timing_roundtrip: slide with a 2-node p:timing (delay/duration on inner anim node) -> parse -> tree depth 2 with delay values -> serialize -> reparse -> same values; and gap_pptx_smartart_survives: pptx with ppt/diagrams/data1.xml -> parse -> serialize -> zip contains ppt/diagrams/data1.xml byte-same. Keep all green.
